integrity: The continuum optimization is reduced to finitely many rational polyhedral support cells. Exact arithmetic verifies every cell endpoint and every candidate quadratic; numerical sampling is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats one real two-dimensional hexagonal norm and one parameterized isosceles von Neumann–Jordan constant.
It does not classify the same constant on arbitrary polygonal planes or general Banach spaces.
The literature comparison cannot exclude an obscure independent correction under substantially different notation.
title: Exact isosceles von Neumann–Jordan profile of the \(\ell_\infty-\ell_1\) hexagonal plane
